purpose: Machine-checkable same-lineage receipt contract for PREWRITE/CAS, sanitized RETURN and durable ingest evidence.
invariants: prewrite.expected_blob MUST equal prewrite.observed_blob at the fenced prewrite observation
return.lineage_id and ingest.lineage_id MUST equal the top-level lineage_id
return.work_item_id and ingest.work_item_id MUST equal the top-level work_item_id
return.path MUST be a bounded coordination path
no private payload keys may appear in the public receipt
truth_boundary: A valid receipt proves envelope consistency only. G05 evidence keys become PASS only when an independent verifier reopens receipts from one real lineage and the underlying runtime actions are actually evidenced.
